profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with 5+ years of experience delivering scalable applications and streamlining processes, built on a foundation of 15 years in hospitality and formal education in architecture and engineering. My journey into tech wasn’t traditional, but it’s given me a unique perspective, balancing analytical problem-solving with user-centric design and a deep understanding of people.

My time in hospitality taught me how to adapt quickly, work under pressure, and communicate effectively, all essential skills in fast-paced engineering environments. Leading teams in high-volume restaurants shaped my ability to collaborate, mentor, and drive efficiency, which translates directly into my engineering work. My background in architecture and design thinking has refined my approach to structuring scalable systems, optimizing data flow, and creating intuitive user experiences.

In software development, I specialize in full-stack engineering, with expertise in:

Front-end: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind
Back-end: FastAPI, Python, SQLAlchemy
Databases & Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, CI/CD
Automation & Integrations: Zapier, Web Scraping, Data Pipelines

Whether it’s building robust applications, automating workflows, or designing seamless user experiences, I thrive at the intersection of technical precision and human impact. Let’s connect!

positions.title: Founding Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building scalable web applications and leading technical initiatives to enhance user experiences. At HuCapital, I migrated the standalone HuMatched app into the core platform, improving integration, maintainability, and feature scalability. Supported our beta launch, growing the user base to 500+ active users.

Mentor to junior engineers, I coordinate with overseas teams and implement CI/CD pipelines and automated workflows to boost engineering efficiency. I also leverage AI-assisted development tools (ChatGPT, Gemini) for rapid prototyping, code optimization, and documentation generation, accelerating feature delivery.

Passionate about turning complex workflows into intuitive, high-performance solutions that drive business results.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Express.js · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked in a cross-functional team, contributing to the design, development, and implementation of application features and software solutions to enhance internal user experiences. Leveraged a full-stack skill set including Python, FastAPI, Next.js, Tailwind, React, Vue, and Redis to ensure seamless integration, scalability, and high performance across front-end and back-end systems.

Built a media deduplication ETL system that automated manual processes, cutting man-hours by 84% while maintaining 85–90% accuracy. Developed an intuitive data management platform that boosted internal productivity by 60% and integrated real-time ETL updates, improving processing efficiency by 30%.

Optimized existing codebases, implemented robust security measures, participated in code reviews, and contributed to agile sprints to continuously improve development processes. Leveraged AI-assisted development tools (ChatGPT, Gemini) for rapid prototyping, code optimization, and documentation, accelerating feature delivery and reducing debugging time.

Passionate about designing scalable, efficient solutions that empower teams and drive measurable business impact.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · FastAPI · JavaScript · Next.js · Python (Programming Language) · Tailwind CSS · SQLAlchemy · Redis · Pandas · React.js

positions.title: Associate Application Developer
positions.description: Continued technical training in React, Python and SQL to meet company and client standards. Developed skills in software development, debugging, cloud computing, etc. through structured learning. Remained available for project assignments based on client demand.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
IBM Apprenticeship Program, which lasts approximately 12 months, is an official registered apprenticeship recognized by the Department of Labor (DOL). Every graduate of a Registered Apprenticeship program receives a nationally-recognized credential from the DOL.

During the apprenticeship duration, apprentices will be required to complete specific learning hours and on the job training that has been outlined to ensure we are developing the skills and competencies essential to the role.

positions.title: Architectural Intern
positions.description: Created blueprints and 3D floor plans based on client specifications, suggested changes as needed. Performed detailed measurements at client site and applied to the schematics. Worked with vendors to ensure timely delivery of orders to meet project deadlines and win bids
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Collaborative Problem Solving

positions.title: Server
positions.description: Ensured customer satisfaction at high volume airport bar, working with a variety of clientele. Performed a myriad of tasks as needed to keep multiple restaurants efficiently running. Stocked inventory, estimated needs, replenished orders; opened and closed restaurant.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Collaborative Problem Solving

projects.title: Eco Share
projects.description:
Eco-Share. A fun, interactive social media web application. Where creatives from all over the world can come together and share their eco-friendly designs. In hopes of inspiring others to incorporate sustainability within their artistry. As well as possible networking to come together to make the world a better place!

Tech Stack Used
--Active Record
--Ruby on Rails 
--JavaScript 
--React.js 
--Redux.js

projects.title: EZ Task
projects.description:
A clean simple application intended to serve as an extension of a desktop. With the functionality of organization in a posted notes format. 

Tech Stack Used

--Active Record 
--Ruby on Rails 
--Vanilla JavaScript
